notes: Added required story set for FEAT-3 covering schema, core logic, API integration, and testing.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Input/Output Schema
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, recruiting status, distance, duration). Ensure strict contract alignment with tool router.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov with recruiting filter, extract trial locations, and compute travel distance and duration using external routing APIs.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search API Integration
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials search into EvaluateCare facade and tool router, enabling chat-triggered execution and structured response delivery to frontend.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests for clinical trials search, covering schema validation, API responses, distance computation, and error handling scenarios.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test file found; tests must be created following existing backend test patterns in Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/
